goal:
T81 — the scoreboard states its own significance (v3.6 rule: no claim the data does not support). Production v5,
equal tools: EvoForge solved 12/12, single 9/12, paired 3-0 with 9 ties — not significant at n=12.
1. evoforge/arena.py summary(): equal_tools gets "stats" computed over the scored equal-tools matches:
   {"tasks": n, "solved": {"single", "evoforge"} (a side solved a match when its held-out passed == n > 0),
    "wilson95": {"single": [lo, hi], "evoforge": [lo, hi]} (Wilson score interval, z = 1.96, each bound rounded to 3
    decimals; null when n = 0), "decisive": {"evoforge": wins, "single": wins},
    "sign_test_p": exact two-sided binomial sign test over decisive matches (ties excluded; p = min(1, 2 * P(X <= min)),
    X ~ Bin(m, 0.5)); null when there are no decisive matches, "significant": p is not null and p < 0.05}.
2. Web: the home and Arena scoreboard cards show, under the equal-tools line, the solved counts with their intervals and
   one plain sentence: arena.summary-significant ("Statistically significant (p = ...)") or
   arena.summary-not-significant ("Not statistically significant yet (p = ...); more matches needed"). Read the value
   from equal_tools.stats.sign_test_p. en + ko. Fits 375px.
